Randomized Acupuncture Study

Abstract

This clinical study evaluated the effectiveness of acupuncture for the management of chronic lower back pain.

Methods

Participants were randomly assigned to an acupuncture treatment group or a control group.

Patients in the intervention group received acupuncture twice weekly for eight weeks.

Results

Participants receiving acupuncture reported improvement in pain scores compared with the control group.

Data Availability

The data generated during this study are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
